theme.rationale: For a hyperlocal marketplace serving consumers and street vendors in Dehradun, a light theme feels approachable, trustworthy, and matches daylight shopping scenarios. It ensures high legibility for price comparisons and dense vendor data.

headings.rationale: Friendly, modern, and highly legible. It bridges the gap between consumer trust and vendor professionalism.

body.rationale: Clean sans-serif for high density data and price grids. Provides excellent readability at small sizes.

rules: No Inter, Roboto, or Open Sans for headings.
Labels must be uppercase, tracking-[0.2em], text-xs.
Max H1 size is text-5xl or text-6xl. No text-8xl for hero.

colors.primary_description: Deep Grocer Green (Tailwind Emerald/Green 700-800 equivalent). Communicates freshness, local produce, and trust.
colors.accent_description: Amber/Warm Orange for flash sales, trial badges, and primary call-to-actions.
rules: Do NOT use pure #000000 or #808080. Tint greys with a warm undertone (Stone/Warm Gray).
Never use full transparent backgrounds in headers or dropdowns. ALWAYS use glassmorphism or solid colors.

consumer_search.cards: Subtle border, shadow-sm hover:shadow-md transition-all. Image on top, price and vendor details below.

vendor_dashboard.widgets: Flat solid surfaces, 1px subtle border, no shadow by default. Hover adds slight lift.

rules: Containers with border must have internal padding (p-4 to p-6) on text content to avoid collision.
Generous spacing: use p-6 or p-8 for main sections.
Images must not exceed max-h-[80vh] on mobile.

components.cards: Avoid heavily rounded corners. Use rounded-lg max. 1px border. Solid background for vendor side.
components.buttons: Pill-shaped (rounded-full) for consumer CTAs. Sharp or rounded-md for vendor data actions.
components.navigation: Sticky glassmorphism header (backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/80) with 1px bottom border. Must have Logo, Links, and CTA.
components.badges: Use for '30-Day Trial', 'In Stock', 'Out of Stock'. Small, bold, high contrast.
components.inputs: Shadcn components heavily customized to match the brand. Warm gray borders.
components.tables: Dense. Use Shadcn table. Zebra stripes for readability in vendor product lists.

rules: Hover states for all interactive elements.
DO NOT use 'transition: all'. Use specific transitions (e.g., transition-colors, transition-transform).
Staggered entrance animations for product lists and dashboard widgets.

visual_enhancers.textures: Subtle noise overlay on the consumer landing page hero to reduce digital flatness.
visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Use 'Crystal Glass' style for sticky headers and modals (backdrop-blur-xl, saturate-150, light inner border).

hero_consumer.description: Local variety store to represent vendors.
Store with bags of food on display.
Indian street vendor cart with fresh items.
Landscape of Dehradun for local context.

instructions_to_main_agent: Preserve the core message and flow of the existing landing page, but upgrade its UI using these guidelines.
Build the Consumer Product Search page at /search. It must have filters for city (default Dehradun), search bar, and display price comparison cards.
Build the Vendor Dashboard at /vendor/dashboard. Include a Free Trial banner/badge (30-day trial).
Build the Vendor Product Management page at /vendor/products for adding/editing capped products (15 limit after trial).
Build the Subscription/Paywall page at /vendor/pricing integrating Razorpay for ₹199/month or ₹1499/year plans.
All interactive elements MUST have data-testid attributes.
Use sonner for toast notifications. File extension must be .js or .jsx, NOT .tsx.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Avoid the 'AI slop' aesthetic. Make creative, distinctive frontends.
Do NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur) for sticky navs.
You MUST NOT apply universal transition (e.g., transition: all). Add transitions for specific properties.
You MUST NOT center align the app container in index.css.
Use modern button styles (pill-shaped or sharp) with interaction animations.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters for icons.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Use provided image URLs. NEVER use placeholder text for missing images.
Ensure the vendor dashboard feels like a high-end SaaS while retaining the brand colors.
accessibility: Ensure contrast meets APCA/WCAG standards. Test text over images.
Always set hover text color explicitly.
